name: Taste
overview: Scripture uses the sense of taste both literally and metaphorically to reveal spiritual truths. The psalmist invites believers to 'taste and see that the LORD is good,' encouraging a personal experience of God's goodness (Psalms 34:8), while also describing God's word as sweeter than honey to the palate (Psalms 119:103). Taste can be lost or diminished with age, as illustrated by the lament of David questioning his ability to discern or taste (2 Samuel 19:35). Additionally, the enjoyment of food and drink with joy is affirmed as a blessing from God (Ecclesiastes 9:7; Luke 12:19), pointing to the goodness of God’s provision and the call to live with grateful contentment.
